negative_evidence_contract: All preserved failures remain executable; previously passing comparisons and valid-input parseability must be preserved. Maker results are not acceptance.
invariant: Successful native command execution selects Class regardless of root/group placement. A multiline note owns exactly its chosen terminator; note targets resolve quark data including groups. Package visibility and qualified note identity survive consumption.
causal_divergence: The native trial imposes an extraneous nonempty-package prerequisite. Notes recognize only end-note termination and lookup entity_by_path only; Java resolves Quark<Entity> data which can be a group. Ordinary package visibility and dotted note code grammar are absent. Failed class trials can therefore fall through and lose native declarations.
planned_change: Remove the package prerequisite for executed native commands; represent the selected note terminator in parser state, allow group target lookup, retain package visibility and dotted note aliases. Route group-attached notes through the same group endpoint layout used by ordinary links. Reject missing targets and duplicate quark materialization; do not ignore unknown commands or alter scores.
